# kit (vendored)

A pinned copy of the @rebel/ui composition layer (kit), written by `rebel-kit sync`. Don't edit
anything in this folder: style a page with its own sheet, and rerun `rebel-kit sync <this folder>`
from @rebel/ui to update. `kit.lock.json` records the version, rev and a sha256 per file.

Themes here: house, paper, obsidian, midnight-cyan, slate-amber.

## Render and check a view (Node >= 22, nothing else)

```bash
node kit/render.mjs view.json -o page.html                    # static page, sheets linked by relative path
node kit/render.mjs view.json --inline -o page.html            # one standalone file
node kit/render.mjs view.json --host artifact -o page.artifact.html   # claude.ai Artifact body
node kit/render.mjs view.json --themes house,paper -o all.html # theme switch; opens on the view's theme
node kit/render.mjs pack page.html -o page.artifact.html     # a hand-written kit page as an Artifact body
node kit/render.mjs check page.html view.json                  # contract lint + view validation (exit 1 on a problem)
node kit/render.mjs verify                                     # every file still matches kit.lock.json
```

Flags match `rebel-kit render`: `--theme`, `--themes`, `--mode light|dark|auto`, `--host static|artifact`,
`--inline`, `--base <url>`, `--no-fonts`, `--out-dir`. A view's `theme` must be one of the themes above
(or a path to your own `*.vars.css`).

## In a page you write by hand

Link `themes/<slug>.vars.css`, then `kit.css`, then `blocks.css`, and put `data-kit data-shell="page"` on
`<body>`. `render.js` is the renderer as an ES module (`RebelKit.mount(view)` in a browser). The block
registry is `blocks.json`; views validate against `view.schema.json`. Fonts per theme: `themes.json`.
To publish a hand-written page as a claude.ai Artifact, `node kit/render.mjs pack page.html -o page.artifact.html`
inlines everything it links and swaps `data-mode` for the viewer's light/dark choice.
